data.name: GuideText
data.value:
ClipCompose copies saved templates, inserting the clipboard text where needed.
1. Templates ClipCompose starts in the notification area without opening a window. Create categories and templates on the Templates tab of Settings (right-click the tray icon > Settings…). Put {{clipboard}} in a template where the copied text should go. A template without {{clipboard}} is copied as is, and the clipboard is not read.
2. Run with the mouse (no hotkey needed) Click the tray icon, choose a template and press Enter (or double-click). The result is copied; paste it with Ctrl+V. You can also copy the pinned template from the tray menu. In the chooser, the pin button (Ctrl+P) pins or unpins a template, Text (Ctrl+Space) shows the template text, and Alt+↑↓ or dragging reorders templates (Alt+Shift+↑↓ or dragging a heading moves a category). Settings closes the chooser and opens Settings. Click a category heading (or press Enter or ←→ while the search box is empty) to collapse or expand it; ClipCompose remembers which categories are collapsed. The search box finds templates by template or category name (separate words with spaces to narrow the results). Windows may hide new tray icons under the ^ (Show hidden icons) button. To keep the icon visible, open Settings > Personalization > Taskbar > Other system tray icons and turn on ClipCompose, or drag the icon onto the taskbar.
3. Run with hotkeys (optional) Hotkeys are not set by default. In Settings, set a hotkey for normal mode (open the chooser) and for pinned mode (run the pinned template without the chooser). With hotkeys, ClipCompose can also paste automatically into the window you were using. Automatic paste is off by default in normal mode and on in pinned mode. It does not work in every app; if nothing is pasted, press Ctrl+V.
4. When the clipboard is read The clipboard is read when you confirm a template, not when you press the hotkey. If the clipboard still holds ClipCompose's previous result, it asks you to copy the source text again.
5. Clipboard history and protection If the copied text was marked by its app as excluded from clipboard history or cloud sync (for example, by a password manager), ClipCompose applies the same marks to the result. Results of templates without {{clipboard}} are ordinary copies and may appear in Windows clipboard history or in other clipboard apps such as PlainClip. These marks are not a guarantee against every app.
6. Data Templates and settings are saved only on this PC (the folder is shown on the General tab of Settings). Copied text and results are not saved. Use Export and Import to move templates to another PC. Export saves the categories you choose to one file. Import (add) adds the categories you choose from a file and keeps your current data; Restore (replace all) replaces all templates with the file.
7. Start when you sign in In the Microsoft Store version, turn on "Start ClipCompose when I sign in to Windows" on the General tab of Settings. It is off by default. If it was turned off in Windows settings (Startup apps), turn it on there.
